title: Sonic Jam
overview:
Run!! Run!! Sonic the Hedgehog runs!!

Sonic runs. Toward the shining sun.

Sonic runs. Chest out, fair and square.

Sonic runs. Together with the sun, as far as it goes.

Sonic runs. Never stopping, he keeps running with all his might.

Sonic Jam gathers Sonic the Hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic the Hedgehog 3 and Sonic & Knuckles on one disc. Combine Sonic 3 with Sonic & Knuckles, or take Knuckles into Sonic 2, just as the lock-on cartridge allowed. Play each game in Original, Normal or Easy mode, try Time Attack, or jump straight into the Special Stages.

Between games, run Sonic freely around Sonic World, a 3D hub. Visit its buildings to browse a museum of artwork, manuals, character profiles, music and commercials, and take on missions such as collecting rings and finding Tails.

- Four classic Sonic games
- For 1 or 2 players
- Compatible with the multi controller
- Memory backup support

走る!! 走る!! ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグが走る!!

ソニックは走る。輝く太陽に向かって。

ソニックは走る。胸を張って正々堂々と。

ソニックは走る。太陽と一緒にどこまでも。

ソニックは走る。立ち止まらずに力いっぱい走り続ける。
